objective: Test whether a qualified4096-visit offline teacher improves the unchanged-size student at64 visits; separate teacher-data effect from extra training.

requiredImplementation.purpose: Deterministic per-game RNG, pooled WebGPU teacher selfplay and complete-game labels.
Replay the same saved roots and produce paired noise-free64/4096-visit labels.

checks: Extend ordinary-versus-pooled search equivalence to4096 visits on fixed roots of every board.
Complete12 canary games (two per board) at65 visits; verify every move and label.
RNG must depend on game seed, not concurrent scheduling; compare serial and pooled canary trajectories.
Freeze code/inputs and all game IDs before48-game data generation.
preflight.failure: Stop on semantic mismatch. Infrastructure retries must use the same seed and retain attempt records; never replace a bad-outcome or capped game.

corpus.perGameSeed: FNV1a32(`${seed}|${kind}|${size}|${gameIndex}`), zero maps to1; store all48 derived seeds before execution.
corpus.completionGate: All48 games must end legally with consistent WDL/score/ownership. A cap fails the data-generation stage; save completed games and logs without replacing capped games.

split.unit: whole origin game, fixed per board before collection
split.policy: All positions and relabelings from one origin game stay in one partition. Earlier192 teacher-screen games are not training data.

corpus.gameIdSeedField: derived per-game seed, as fixed in game-split.json

reanalysis.roots: Every saved pre-move root in the48 completed games; no outcome-based filtering or phase subsampling.
reanalysis.target: 0.75*searchPolicy+0.25*noise-free legal NN prior for each recipe.
reanalysis.commonValidationPolicy: teacher4096 smoothed target for both arms; record as validationPolicy.
reanalysis.sharedPolicyEligibility: Eligible iff neither search reports provenLoss. Use the same policyEligible and decisionReason on both arms; retain WDL/score/ownership even when policy supervision is excluded.
retain: origin game and complete move history
raw search policy and noise-free prior
raw per-action visits/Q/priors and root NN WDL
reanalysis.comparabilityGate: Identical ordered position IDs, features, masks, legality, outcomes, split, common validation targets and eligibility across arms; only the training policy recipe differs.

training.architecture: Same64x6/120905-parameter GraphNet as baseline; no large teacher model in this pilot.
training.resume: same frozen baseline checkpoint for both arms
training.sampling: same source/board/game/thirds balance and sampled index order for both arms
training.selection: Minimum common normal-position validation loss at epochs0,4,8; anchors excluded. No later checkpoint/seed search on this holdout.

gate.candidate: teacher4096 arm only; control is a matched extra-training comparator, not another selected candidate.
gate.commonLoss: lower than baseline epoch0 on identical validation roots
gate.other: All outputs finite; architectures/search/features unchanged. Save all checkpoints and metrics. Gate failure stops strength testing.
gate.metricCorpus: Shared normal held-out roots using common teacher validationPolicy and shared eligibility.

development.search: frozen production sh8 WASM, FPU1, Qscale0.4 for both players
development.selectionGate: Both comparisons: scoreRate>=0.60, corrected97.5% lower>0.50, everyboard>=8/16, no caps/illegal. Do not pool the two comparisons or call them independent replications.
development.note: Same opening pairs may be shared across opponents; inference accounts for pairing within each comparison. If control selected epoch0, report baseline/control identity explicitly.

confirmation.condition: Only after both development comparisons pass; freeze the same candidate with no retuning.
confirmation.gate: scoreRate>=0.55, paired95% lower>0.50, everyboard>=16/32, no caps/illegal.
confirmation.note: One frozen candidate, fresh opening seeds; report per-board point gates as observations, not a non-inferiority proof.

performance.condition: Only after strength confirmation; ordinary application inference/search, not pooled inference.
performance.gate: paired P95 ratio candidate/baseline<=1.05 overall and<=1.10 on every board

outputs: raw complete selfplay games and dataset
both paired relabeled corpora and fixed split manifest
both selected student packages and saved checkpoints
all validation/group metrics and common-corpus fingerprint
exact executed source, commands, environment, hashes and final decision
stopRules: Any illegal move, inconsistent label, split leakage or source/hash drift stops the stage.
Capped games are retained in reports and fail qualification; do not resample replacements.
No interim efficacy stopping or repeated arena looks to change training/selection.
Do not silently add completed-Q targets, larger models or extra hyperparameters; register a new study if needed.
nonGoals: No browser model/WASM installation,main merge or deployment.
No claim that teacher win rate predicts distilled-student strength.
No GNN/Attention capacity sweep or completed-Q target arm in this first controlled pilot.
nextAction: Implement and validate pooled WebGPU selfplay and paired reanalysis before generating the48-game corpus.
